contract.provides: P1 proposes restricted-port assembly of commercial capillary stock, universal retaining rails/clips and a custom micro-Y inside a closed host. Its introduced hydraulic and stock/schedule calculations support conditional screening of three layouts. The complete manufacturing/renewal operation, micro-Y and microgripper remain unqualified, and the required cost/turnaround advantage was not demonstrated. Proposed36mm OD/33mm ID316L host; four1mm fluid ports and two1.8mm service ports; .8mm OD/.5mm ID FEP stock, reusable rails/clips and1.7mm custom micro-Y. External routing and borescope tools withdraw before passive use.
